name: Sonic / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Three strong sonic pressure pulses start a sustained metallic resonant ring. Hold the wavering descending harmonic ring at a clearly audible level for 3.5 seconds. No electricity. Do not fade early. Fade only in the last 0.3 seconds. No voice, scream, music, gunshot or reverb.
